statement: A pallet, including its load, may weigh at most 800 kg.
notice: New insurance terms: from now on a pallet, load included, may weigh at most 800 kg (was 1,000 kg).

statement: Forklifts must not exceed 8 km/h inside the building.
notice: After a near-miss we are lowering the indoor forklift speed limit to 8 km/h (was 10 km/h).

statement: Our contracted curtain-side trailers carry a payload of 22000 kg.
notice: Our haulier switched to a lighter trailer fleet: trailer payload is now 22,000 kg (was 24,000 kg).

statement: Damaged-goods write-offs above 750 EUR need warehouse-manager approval.
notice: Shift supervisors may now approve damaged-goods write-offs up to 750 EUR; above that the warehouse manager approves (was 500 EUR).

statement: Each outbound door handles 4 trailer loads per shift.
notice: With the new loading crew each outbound door now handles 4 trailer loads per shift (was 3).
